svg.title: A footprint that takes either of two packages
svg.desc: Drawn to scale, plan views. Left: a SOT-23-6 footprint, six pads 0.6 by 1.1 mm on a 0.95 mm pitch in two rows 2.5 mm apart, with the six pads of a small 1.0 by 0.8 mm leadless package in the space between the rows; each leadless pad is joined to the SOT-23 pad beside it by a short trace under the mask. Either package can be fitted. Right: for packages that can't share space, a SOT-23-6 footprint and an SC-70-6 footprint side by side, labeled U1 and U2, each pin wired to the same net as its partner (traces not shown); the BOM fits one and marks the other DNP.

g.text: Drawn to scale. Dimensions in mm; pad sizes are examples.
Right: traces not shown; each pin shares a net with its partner.
Use a combined footprint only where the part maker publishes one;
name the fitted package on the BOM.
